rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a blastocyst showing a large cavity and visible cell clusters, but it overstates confidence in calling the ICM tightly packed and TE uniformly cohesive from this single image; the image appears somewhat less crisp than an ideal AA morphology assessment.
Thoroughly integrates age, PCOS, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, prior IVF failures, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with appropriate emphasis on morphology versus aneuploidy and recurrent failure history; only minor tension exists between calling prognosis strong and acknowledging substantial prior failure-related uncertainty.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET preference, uterine cavity reassessment after repeated failures, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and avoidance of unsupported add-ons. Minor issue: it labels 3AA as 'highest morphology tier,' whereas higher expansion stages can also be top quality.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including luteal support attention, early monitoring, uterine evaluation, selective PGT-A discussion, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and metabolic optimization.
